EARE.description: Effective Area for Soil Pressure (EARE). Each entry associates an element and one of its nodes with the effective area used for soil pressure computation; the id key is the EARE data key.

ELEM_KEY.description: Element key: the element this effective-area entry is applied to.

NODE_KEY.description: Node key: the node of the element at which the effective area is defined.

EFF_AREA.description: Effective area value used for soil pressure at the given element/node.
